study: ABTS-0 K1 -- reference-free lexical candidate feasibility (no steering, no training, no K2)

panel.role: already-exposed D-dev-select FULL300 (fixed100 + NEW200), 20 dialogues x 15; no confirm/test/router-calib/P3/transfer

inputs.r0_rows: results/inference_cf/r0/run1/rows/{i:03d}.{json,npz}; PRIMARY track_heard_intervals only; reused by audio file hash

engine.name: matched_forced_decode_v1
engine.definition: experiments.inference_cf_cached.Branch.step(new, capture_layer=16, attention=True) + core_p1.processed_argmax (lowest-ID ties); identical loop to episodic_tta.forced_decode / ttls.greedy_decode
engine.excluded: experiments.inference_cf_cached.cached_greedy (torch.topk tie-breaking; 59/300 forced-ZH divergences, all at exact ties)
engine.auto: native single-SOT detection (generation _retrieve_init_tokens, lowest-ID argmax verified) then matched_forced_decode under the detected prompt
engine.suppression: generation_config.suppress_tokens every step; begin_suppress_tokens at content step 0 only

alignment.source: cached current-query attention returned by Branch.step at every decode step of the branch's own history
alignment.rows: row s = query predicting content token s (prediction-query offset -1); EOS row included when terminated by EOS; capped decodes time T-1 tokens
alignment.standardize: per frame over the available prediction rows (mean/std, ddof 0, std floor 1e-8)

candidates.encoding: candidate c: tokenizer.encode(' ' + surface, add_special_tokens=False); B0 block b: tokenizer.encode(block_surface, add_special_tokens=False); every piece < eos and not in suppress_tokens

region.s1_functions: csasr.inference_cf.s1_evidence.heard_attention / select_target / select_offtarget, unchanged, with the S1 config
region.attention_query: B0 branch cached attention at the target query (row t)

selection.rule: earliest structurally eligible pair per utterance (steps 2-3), before any acoustic scoring
selection.on_verification_failure: abstain; never try a later proposal

scoring.F: mean_j log P(w_j | a, p, w_<j); float32 log_softmax of processed full-vocabulary logits, upcast float64
scoring.mask: csasr.inference_cf.lexical_compatibility.hard_mask (positive float32 zero, half-open, bytes outside preserved)
scoring.replay: fresh cold Branch per (condition, word): prompt, then B0 prefix tokens one per step, then candidate pieces one per step

controls.unfiltered_U0: every forced-EN heard word whose casefold is absent from all B0 Latin words
controls.structural_U2: every step-2+3 eligible proposal (all, not only the earliest)
controls.off_target_only: accept iff A_off(c) - A_off(b) >= ln 2 on the scored pairs
controls.shuffled: R0 heard track circularly shifted by floor(heard/2); steps 3-4 rebuilt; no extra acoustic scoring

outputs.archive_contents: per-utterance packed bf16 alignment-head attention (heard frames) for B0 and EN branches, content-addressed

compute.job: one Slurm job, H100 MIG 3g.40gb, bf16, wall limit 2h

evaluator.timing_proxy: R0 oracle source: MMS-FA CTC reference-unit timing via experiments.inference_cf_r0_analyze.oracle_tracks; NOT ground truth
evaluator.en_fraction: canonical units (evaluation.normalization.segment_units(normalize_text(reference))): EN units / all units
evaluator.literal: a canonical reference EN unit equal to the normalized candidate whose CTC interval overlaps the candidate's EN-word interval; sensitivity: +-200 ms

artifact_taxonomy.acronym: single-letter EN unit adjacent to another single-letter EN unit
artifact_taxonomy.boundary_join: PIER category boundary_error, or Latin hypothesis token containing the reference word as a strict substring

evaluator.genuine: B0-wrong (PIER categorize against matched-engine B0) and not an artifact
evaluator.reachable_onset: genuine run whose onset unit is Han-substituted in B0 (wrong_language_substitution / phonetic_transliteration_or_script), B0 aligned unit index > 0, CTC onset inside the heard horizon

labels.K1_BLOCKED: engineering/data prerequisite unresolved, or any integrity check failed
labels.K1_INSUFFICIENT: reachable genuine MM onsets < 12 or in < 6 dialogues, or < 3 dialogues with both literal and nonliteral scored MM pairs
labels.K1_FAIL: measurable, but any go_MM condition fails
labels.K1_PASS: every go_MM condition holds; makes K2 eligible for human review only
